editorial.intro: Explore Australian flag clipart featuring the Southern Cross stars and Union Jack in flat flags, fabric views and line art.
paragraphs: The corner Union Jack and Southern Cross give this Australian flag clipart two details to look for. Both show clearly in the straighter flag views, while waving fabric gives the same design a looser outline.

Choose among {{artworkCount}} illustrations for an Australia report or a personal travel page. A clean flag can sit beside a map, and an outline leaves the star positions visible for students to color.

editorial.intro: Browse Canadian flag clipart with red maple leaf flags, folded fabric, waving displays and outline illustrations.
paragraphs: A red maple leaf sits in the white center of the Canadian flag clipart, with red panels on both sides. Compare flat designs with waving fabric to find a version where the leaf is as prominent as you need it to be.
Choose from {{artworkCount}} illustrations for a Canada Day card or a student presentation on Canadian symbols. A simple flag leaves space to label the leaf and the outer panels.
